import json, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
from harness import *

failures=[]
def check(name, got, want):
    if got != want:
        failures.append(name); print('FAIL',name); print('  got ',json.dumps(got,sort_keys=True)[:300]); print('  want',json.dumps(want,sort_keys=True)[:300])
    else: print('ok  ',name)

def base(**kw):
    doc={"seed":"s","definitions":[],"timeout_ms":10,"cases":[],"events":[],"channels":[]}
    doc.update(kw); return doc

REQ = b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h\r\n\r\n'
EXPECT={"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"h"}

# repeated complete requests exceed the request budget quickly
doc = base(definitions=[["r","b'%s'"%REQ.decode('latin-1').replace('\r','\\r').replace('\n','\\n')]],
           cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[],"expect":EXPECT}],
           channels=[{"name":"e","parts":[{"case":None,"data":"{{r*50000}}"}]}])
t0=time.time(); r=run(json.dumps(doc)); dt=time.time()-t0
print('   repeated requests %.2fs' % dt)
check('repeated requests budget', r, {"error":"input"})

# repeated request just under the budget: 20000 requests
doc = base(definitions=[["r","b'%s'"%REQ.decode('latin-1').replace('\r','\\r').replace('\n','\\n')]],
           cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[],"expect":EXPECT}],
           channels=[{"name":"e","parts":[{"case":None,"data":"{{r*20000}}"}]}])
t0=time.time(); r=run(json.dumps(doc)); dt=time.time()-t0
print('   20000 compressed requests %.2fs' % dt)
ch = r['channels'][0]
check('compressed requests count', len(ch['requests']), 20000)
check('compressed requests error', ch['error'], None)
check('compressed bytes n', ch['bytes']['n'], len(REQ)*20000)
check('compressed owner', ch['requests'][19999]['owner'], None)
check('compressed flags', ch['requests'][19999]['flags'], ['extra','unattributed'])
check('compressed committed last', ch['committed'], [20000])

# no LF in a huge part -> syntax detected fast
doc = base(definitions=[["big","b'x'*1000000000"]],
           cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[],"expect":EXPECT}],
           channels=[{"name":"e","parts":[{"case":None,"data":"{{big}}"}]}])
t0=time.time(); r=run(json.dumps(doc)); dt=time.time()-t0
print('   huge no-lf %.2fs' % dt)
check('huge no-lf', r['channels'][0]['error'], {'kind':'syntax','offset':0})

# huge prefix just under the limit -> incomplete
doc = base(definitions=[["big","b'GET / HTTP/1.1\\r\\n'+'x'*8173"]],
           cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[],"expect":EXPECT}],
           channels=[{"name":"e","parts":[{"case":None,"data":"{{big}}"}]}])
r=run(json.dumps(doc))
check('huge prefix incomplete', r['channels'][0]['error'], {'kind':'incomplete','offset':0})

# 20000 zero chunks under the budget, then a zero beyond it
body = b'0\r\n\r\n'*20000
doc = base(definitions=[["c","b'%s'"%(b'0\\r\\n\\r\\n'.decode('latin-1'))]],
           cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[],"expect":EXPECT}],
           channels=[{"name":"e","parts":[{"case":None,"data":"GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nTransfer-Encoding: chunked\r\n\r\n"},
                                          {"case":None,"data":"{{c*20000}}"}]}])
t0=time.time(); r=run(json.dumps(doc)); dt=time.time()-t0
print('   zero chunks %.2fs' % dt)
check('zero chunks ok', r['channels'][0]['error'], None)
check('zero chunks body', r['channels'][0]['requests'][0]['body'], fp(b''))
check('zero chunk committed', r['channels'][0]['committed'], [0,1])

# chunk data spanning a repeat definition
doc = base(definitions=[["z","b'Q'*100000"]],
           cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[],"expect":EXPECT}],
           channels=[{"name":"e","parts":[{"case":None,"data":"GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nTransfer-Encoding: chunked\r\n\r\n"},
                                          {"case":None,"data":"186A0\r\n"},
                                          {"case":None,"data":"{{z*10}}"},
                                          {"case":None,"data":"\r\n0\r\n\r\n"}]}])
r=run(json.dumps(doc))
check('repeat chunk error', r['channels'][0]['error'], None)
check('repeat chunk n', r['channels'][0]['requests'][0]['body']['n'], 1000000)
def fpb(b):
    h=0
    for x in b: h=(h*257+x+1)%(2**64)
    return '%016x'%h
want = int(fpb(b'Q'*100000),16)*((pow(257,100000,2**64)*10-1)//(pow(257,100000,2**64)-1))%(2**64) if False else None
# reference via geometric sum
def geo(k,m):
    t=0;b=1
    for bit in bin(k)[2:]:
        t=t*(1+b)%(2**64); b=b*b%(2**64)
        if bit=='1': t=(t+b)%(2**64); b=b*m%(2**64)
    return t
want = int(fpb(b'Q'*100000),16)*geo(10,pow(257,100000,2**64))%(2**64)
check('repeat chunk hash', r['channels'][0]['requests'][0]['body']['h'], '%016x'%want)

# sparse capture: empty parts between content parts
doc = base(cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[],"expect":EXPECT}],
           channels=[{"name":"e","parts":[{"case":None,"data":""},{"case":"a","data":REQ[:10].decode()},
                                          {"case":None,"data":""},{"case":"a","data":REQ[10:].decode()},
                                          {"case":None,"data":""}]}])
r=run(json.dumps(doc))
check('sparse committed', r['channels'][0]['committed'], [0,0,0,1,1])
check('sparse owners', r['channels'][0]['requests'][0]['owners'], [['a',len(REQ)]])

print('FAILURES:', len(failures))
